title: Page 159
transc:
Hd Qrs Genl Butler May 27 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Snake Harriet May harsh plunder for Jonah zodiac
at the request of Nankin I send to
ask if the point of debarkation can be
changed to Homer the River from that point
to the White house is harrow tortuous &
filled with torpedoes & no know landing exists
on the torrent side of the pamun Key
at the white house zodiac at Homer the
wharves were repaired under my directions before we
left for this point & the landing can
be perfectly covered by sharons & a safe
depot made there of desirable zebra Nankin thinks
time will be saved by the Change in
the order walrus Knox very hot down here
R. OBrien


Washington May 27 . 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Bickford has feeble spoons wire pebble miles insulators
and gradual spoons spikes better send to Wilson
point with him enough material to make out
harrow spoons unity operators sufficient are ordered report
to you advise me often about the work
T. T. Eckert
